senses.gloss:
Bhaṭṭa_Akalaṅka
Jain.
--Vidyānuvāda. mantra. Mysore I. p. 586.

Bhaṭṭa_Akalaṅka
Jain.
Wrote in A. D. 1604 a Kanarese gr. in Skt. in Sūtras, with a C. called Bhāṣāmañjarī an. a. C.. called Bhāṣāmakaranda. Recently doubt has been expressed by some Kanarese scholars re. the same Ak. being the a. of all these three parts of the work.
BORI. 1062, 1063 of 1887-91 (C.. Makaranda). Śravaṇabelgola 177a (Śabdānuśāsana).

Bhaṭṭa_Akalaṅka
16-17th cent. A. D.
--Akalaṅkasaṁhitā or Ak. pratiṣṭhāpāṭha or Ak. pratiṣṭhākalpa; consecration; following Nemicandra's work. Jaina Sid. Bhās. VII. 1. Praśasti, p.. 165-8.

Bhaṭṭa_Akalaṅka
Jain.
--Pravacanapraveśa. Karkal 31 (4). Moodbidri II. 208e. Pannalal Bombay IV. p. 6.

Bhaṭṭa_Ākalaṅka
alias Akalaṅka Bhaṭṭa (17th to 18th century).
-C. Mañjarīmakaranda on his Karnāṭaka Śabdānuśāsana or Bhāṣāmañjarī. BORI. 1062-63 of 1887-91. IO. 5121. Rice p. 308.
Pt.. Bombay, 1874. Bangalore, 1923 (revised edn.).
For a. account of a. see C. Panduranga Bhatta, Contr. of Karnāṭaka to Skt. p.. 229-30; also see Y. Mimamsak, Saṃ. Vyā. Kā Itihās, p. 546. [Page004-a.

Bhaṭṭa_Aparājita
contemporary of Rājaśekhara, C. 900.
--Mṛgāṅkalekhākathā. See Prastāvanā, Karpūramañjarī.
--Sbhv. 1024.

Bhaṭṭa_Aravindalocanācārya
had the title “mahābhāṣya”; of Vātsya gotra; father of Ḍiṇḍima Rāma a. of a C. on Saundaryalaharī (MD. 10874). Hpr. IV. 33 (Ms. of the Saundaryalaharīvyākhyā dated 1775 A. D.).

Bhaṭṭa_Arka
poet. Sbhv. 957.

Bhaṭṭa_Avalokita
poet. Sbhv. 1088.

Bhaṭṭa_Upamanyu
poet. Śp. 3587. Sbhv. 1892 (same verse).

Bhaṭṭa_Kakka
inscriptional poet, a. of the Hansot plates of Cāhamāna Bhartṛvaddha; son of Vastuva an. a. native of Valabhi. Bhand. Ins. of N. I. No. 20. See Epi. Ind. XII. p.. 197-204.

Bhaṭṭa_Kapardin
poet. Sbhv. 3185 (same verse q. a.. Śp. 411).

Bhaṭṭa_Karṇāṭaka
poet. Sbhv. 1262. 1606.

Bhaṭṭakumāra
poet. Śp. 3691. Sbhv. 1614. 2096 (same a. Śp. 3691). 2161. 2165. Subhāṣitaratnakośa 653 (same a. Sbhv. 1614). Vidagdhajanavallabhā of the Kashmirian Vallabhadeva, son of Malhāṇa (p. 24. Travancore ms.). See V. Raghavan, J. of Kerala Uni. Ori. Mss. Lib. (Silver Jubilee Vol.) XII. i-ii. 1963, p. 136 (cApaM muSTirbhavAnyAH).

Bhaṭṭa_kṛṣṇadāsa
--C. Bhaktidīpikā on Hastāmalakapañcādhyāyī (taken from the Prahlādasaṁhitā). Written a. Kāśī in the [Page320-a. Bindumādhava shrine an. published by one Rāghava. MT. 3014.

Bhaṭṭa_Kṛṣṇadāsa
-Hastamuktapañcādhyāya (from Prahalādasaṃhitā). Utkal Uni. 2926.

Bhaṭṭa_kṛṣṇapuradeva_(?)
of Vātsyāyanagotra. father of Keśavasvāmin (a. of Nānārthārṇavasaṁkṣepa. Pt.. TSS. XXIII).

Bhaṭṭa_Gaṅgādharamiśra
Tāntrik writer q. in Śivānanda's Ṛjuvimarśinī on Nityāṣoḍaśikārṇava, p. 69, Varanaseya Skt. Uni. edn. p.. 69 (2 Anuṣṭubhs), 80 (1 Anuṣṭubh), 134 (4 Anuṣṭubhs).

Bhaṭṭa_Gopāla(lauhitya)
--C. Sāhityacūḍāmaṇi on Mammaṭa's Kāvyaprakāśa. Adyar D. V. 1665.
Q. in C. Kāmadhenu on Vāmana's Kāvyālam3kāra, I. 1. 2. 3, 16.
Pt.. TSS. 88, p. 100. 1926, 1930.
--Camatkāracintāmaṇi. Q. in above. TSS. 88, p. 402.

Bhaṭṭa_Gopāla
